draft.headline: Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan doubts AI will cure cancer in 5-10 years
draft.threads_post:
Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan doubts AI will cure cancer in the next 5 to 10 years.

Narasimhan, who also serves as an Anthropic board member, says tech's "engineering mindset" overlooks complex human biology. His comments push back against ambitious claims recently made by leaders at DeepMind and Anthropic.

Is tech's engineering mindset overestimating what AI can do in biology?
